subject: Crushed boxes
body:
Our order came Friday and 2 of the 6 cases of 12 oz cups were crushed. Cups are bent and unusable. Pics attached.

Not happy. We need these for the weekend.

Luis Romero
Desert Swirl Frozen Yogurt
needs_human_reason: Stock shipping damage reported 3 days after delivery with photos, within the 7-day policy. Free replacement is standard, nothing outside policy.
summary: 2 of 6 cases of IC-12P (order UQ-10455, delivered Fri 3/5) arrived crushed. Send 2 free replacement cases, no return needed. The customer needs them for the weekend.
draft_reply:
Hi Luis,

Sorry about that. We'll send 2 replacement cases of the 12 oz polka dot cups (IC-12P) at no charge, and there's no need to send the crushed ones back.

Your order (UQ-10455) was delivered Friday, so you're well within our 7-day window for shipping damage. Thanks for sending the photos.

We're processing the replacement today. Stock orders placed before 2 pm ship within 1 business day, and we'll send you tracking as soon as it's on the truck. We can't promise it arrives before the weekend, but we'll get it out as fast as we can.

Sorry again for the hassle,
The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: Photos are attached, as the customer says. The team should confirm they show the damage.
